title: Forecast Driver Contract (DC-FORECAST-DRIVER-v1)
description: Sprint 26 WS-A Foresight tier contract. One flat record per forecast-point x driver factor: the deterministic decomposition ('why') behind an occupancy forecast, grounding the reference ontology hcp:Driver ICE (explainedBy from hcp:Forecast; evidencedBy to hcp:ExternalSignal). Driver deltas at a given horizon reconcile to the net change of the parent forecast from its baseline (invariant enforced by the generator + unit tests). Records materialise gold.fact_forecast_driver; row shape is 1:1 with the Gold Delta table. No PHI (ward-level aggregate). ADR-0013 / ADR-0016 apply. See docs/ontology/reference-layer.ttl and docs/ontology/crosswalk.md.

_pseudonymisation_flag.description: ADR-0016 gate 1: driver records are ward-level decomposition rows and contain no patient identifiers by construction.

forecastId.description: Parent occupancy-forecast id (hcp:Forecast the driver explains).

horizonH.description: Horizon offset the decomposition applies to.

delta.description: Signed bed impact of this factor at the horizon (positive = adds occupancy, negative = frees beds).

signalId.description: Optional link to the external signal that evidences this driver (evidencedBy -> hcp:ExternalSignal, DC-EXT-SIGNAL-v1).
